prompt_used: You are given an image. Write a detailed natural language prompt that could have been used to generate this image. Focus on the most salient and unique visual elements such as the subjects, their clothing, expressions, actions, background, and composition. Describe the color palette, lighting, and overall style, including any cinematic or artistic qualities like camera angle, depth of field, or motion. Make the description as accurate and faithful to the image as possible. If small details are uncertain or ambiguous, omit them and prioritize capturing the overall scene, mood, and visual impression. The final prompt should be coherent, evocative, written as if by an expert visual artist or filmmaker recreating the exact scene.
caption:
A group of nine young men are positioned in a spacious, futuristic room with a minimalist design. The ceiling is composed of large, glowing white panels that cast a soft, even light across the scene, creating a crisp, high-contrast atmosphere. The floor is smooth and white, reflecting the light and enhancing the clean, modern aesthetic. Four bright turquoise columns punctuate the otherwise monochrome space, adding a pop of color and structural interest.

The group is split into two lines facing each other, as if preparing for a dance battle or dramatic confrontation. Most of the men wear sleek, dark outfits—black or deep blue jackets and pants with subtle metallic or leather textures, giving a high-fashion, cyberpunk vibe. Two members in the center stand out in white jackets, drawing the viewer’s eye to the focal point of the composition. Their poses are dynamic and expressive, with bent knees and outstretched arms, suggesting movement and tension. The expressions are focused and intense, conveying energy and anticipation.

The camera angle is straight-on at eye level, emphasizing symmetry and balance in the composition. The depth of field is deep, keeping all subjects sharply in focus against the uncluttered background. The overall style is cinematic and contemporary, with a cool-toned color palette dominated by whites, blacks, and blues, and a polished, editorial finish. The mood is charged and dramatic, capturing a moment of poised action within a strikingly modern environment.
